title: Borrow A Boat Rentals
specs: Explore hidden sandbars, mangrove tunnels, and Gulf of Mexico
Daily sightings of bottlenose dolphins in Estero Bay
World-class fishing for snook, redfish, tarpon, snapper year-round
Florida sunsets visible from the water
Boating license required if born after January 1, 1988
Valid driver's license required for all operators
Minimum operator age 21 for bowrider rentals
At least 3–5 years of boating experience required
The Sandbar Social and Gulf Cruiser pontoon boats seat up to 12 guests
Bowrider boats seat up to 10 guests
blurb: Guests rent pontoon or bowrider boats to explore Estero Bay, Fort Myers Beach sandbars, and the Gulf Coast on their own schedule. Boats include life jackets, safety equipment, maps, and a full orientation. Operators must have boating experience and appropriate licenses.
extraNote: $350 refundable damage deposit collected at booking confirmation via Stripe or Venmo · Cancellation allowed up to 48 hours before reservation · Fuel refilling explained upon booking confirmation; pay only for fuel used · Alcohol permitted for passengers but not operators · Imperial River Ramp or Lovers Key docks · Year-round
